consent.title: Send AI requests to Musclog Iron?
consent.body: Your messages, and the details an AI feature needs to answer, such as your workouts, meals and body measurements, go to the Musclog Iron service. It forwards them to OpenRouter, which sends them to the AI model provider. Only zero data retention (ZDR) endpoints are used: those providers do not keep your content or use it for training. OpenRouter also screens every request for child sexual abuse material and may keep a request it flags. Some of these details are health-related, and by agreeing you give your explicit consent to them being processed this way. Musclog's service never stores your messages; it keeps only an identifier for this device and usage counts. You can switch this off at any time.

premium.renewalDisclosure: Musclog Iron is a monthly subscription that renews automatically. Payment is charged to your App Store or Google Play account at confirmation. It renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel it in your store account settings. The price shown is what the store charges.

paywall.headline: Log faster with AI, nothing to set up
paywall.subhead: Musclog Iron runs the AI for you: no key, no account, and only zero data retention AI providers. Everything else in Musclog stays free.

noSetup.title: Nothing to set up
noSetup.desc: No API key and no account. Subscribe, and the coach, meal logging and workout plans work right away.

private.title: Zero data retention
private.desc: Only zero data retention providers are used: they don't keep your messages or train on them, apart from a screening for child abuse material that the law requires. Musclog never stores them either; it keeps only usage counts and a device identifier.

allowance.title: Your own allowance
allowance.desc: A monthly allowance for your subscription, not the daily limit every free user shares.

devices.title: On all your devices
devices.desc: Add another phone or tablet with Restore purchases. They share one allowance.

openSource.title: Keeps Musclog going
openSource.desc: Musclog is open source. Musclog Iron pays for the hosted AI and supports its development.
